exact_statement: Version4 retains A030@3 at its declared scope and adds the following. For any finite-label Boolean selector F(y,x)=g_L(y)(x), with independent uniform control and data cubes and arbitrary shared-data Boolean sources, let c_j=hat(1_{L=j}), b_j=hat(g_j), P(U,t)=(sum_j c_j(U)b_j(t))^2 and Qinc(U,t)=sum_j c_j(U)^2 b_j(t)^2. Qinc is a normalized support-positive reference with the same data marginal as P. The exact conditional-profile conversion cost C=D(P||Qinc) is at most sum_t q(t) log2(k_t), where k_t counts nonzero source amplitudes at t, and hence at most log2(number of sources). The latter bound is sharp for uniform address labels and identical sources. For the even-r>=4 tagged rare-label bent family of PROOF.md, after actual tag outcomes (+,-) of root reach1/4, this conversion has 0<C<3*2^-r/8=(3/4)Inf_s(F). The SAME original U=4I_root, with old debit1/4, pays the two-tag entropy path, the selected conversion, all other full terminals, and every subsequent finite adaptive physical no-reset continuation with the CURRENT reference, leaving more than765/512 unused root units. The exact source references have inherited Z=0, so the conversion is paid from original admission surplus, not Z or cut slack. No universal initial admission or full-FEI theorem is asserted.
